A.discovery: closed by AF rule (no directory listings until the 14-day health gate passes)
A.reading: expected zero; cannot be used to judge the product or the channel

diagnosis.meaning: paid hits arrived but no 402 was issued: the request never reached a priced product

B.discovery: open (402index, facilitator bazaars, MCP registry if it unblocks)
B.reading: the only window where external_hits says anything about discovery

diagnosis.meaning: no paid hits arrived: fix the channel, not the product

na_reason.mcp_registry: cannot be attempted under AF's own rules: publishing needs GitHub device-flow login (one human code entry), which AF will not ask for

listings.source: AF_X402_LISTINGS.json (maintained by AF from real API responses, not inferred)
listings.decision_rule: attempted=0 -> not started, conclude nothing; attempted>0 and accepted=0 -> host/URL problem (fix the URL, not the channel or the product); accepted>0 and paid hits=0 -> discovery problem; paid hits>0 and settled=0 -> product/price problem; settled>0 -> conversion signal

distribution.classification_reason: every inbound hyperlink is AF-authored and there is no external link, no crawler hit and no referrer; a zero hit count still cannot separate 'nobody looked' from 'looked and did not want'
interpretation_rule: external = 0 -> classification stays not_measured, no matter how many self-authored links exist
a discovery conclusion needs an external hyperlink, a crawler hit, or a referrer
sitemap inclusions never count as inbound links in reports
distribution.reading: not measured: every inbound hyperlink is AF-authored (external=0), so a zero hit count cannot separate 'nobody looked' from 'looked and did not want'

rules.next_action: record the numbers as a host-capability failure log; the plan stops at the invalidated window instead of being extended; a new window needs a durable host (owner-only capability)

no external arrival at all: escalate an owner-only channel (repo homepage/topics, human directories) or declare the experiment inconclusive-by-capability. Never change the product or the price on this result, never call it a discovery failure

rules.when: external > 0 AND external_to_product == 0 AND a channel candidate is blocked
rules.next_action: traffic reached the host but never a priced path, and at least one channel is blocked, so distribution was never tested: unblock it or declare inconclusive. Do not call it discovery failure and do not touch the product

rules.when: external > 0 AND external_to_product == 0 AND no candidate tried yet
rules.next_action: arrivals never reached a priced path: check paths, redirects and the storefront link first, then run the next untried channel candidate

rules.when: external > 0 AND external_to_product == 0 AND all candidates tried AND none blocked
rules.next_action: declare the experiment failed for organic discovery: every channel AF can execute was tried and measured, so the gap is capability (external distribution), not product or price. Stop the plan; do not invent a fifth channel after seeing the numbers
requests reached a priced path but no 402 was issued: fix the payment layer before any conclusion about demand
change price tier or trial shape; verify with a labelled price-gate probe before claiming the price is wrong
keep the price; scale the channel that produced the payer and record the first external payment only after the tx is verified on-chain

hits_definition.external: a request from a client that is neither AF (no x-af-self/x-af-nonce, not af-probe) nor a known crawler, to any path on the AF x402 endpoint host
hits_definition.external_to_product: the subset of `external` whose path is a priced product or the manifest root; this is the page-level number, `external` alone is site-level
hits_definition.paid_hits: external_to_product hits that reached the payment layer (trial calls and AF probes excluded)
hits_definition.crawlers: tracked separately in crawler_hits and never subtracted from paid_hits; reachability reads this field, the funnel does not
hits_definition.best_effort: UA and referrer are self-reported, so organic classification is best-effort and not adversarial-proof: a forged UA can be misread, in either direction

exit_criteria.no_report_only_rule: reporting 'not_measured' with no next action is not an allowed ending: every branch names a next step

current.next_action: window opens 2026-12-11 and closes 2026-12-25; exit rules are already declared

reading: A zero only counts inside window B. In window A discovery is closed by AF's own rule, so zero is the expected value and proves nothing about the product or the channel.
